_readme: All $ in millions. Quarter labels like 2026Q4. Index 0 = Q3'26 (calibration quarter, from data/historicals.json). Every value here is an assumption unless its _src says S-1. Scenario blocks override `common` (deep merge).

contracts._src: S-1 MD&A 'Infrastructure Service Arrangements'. Totals/windows are S-1; ramp shapes are assumptions.

cloud.label: Pre-2026 CSP minimums
cloud._src: S-1 Note 13: non-cancelable purchase commitments as of 12/31/25

cloud.label: SpaceXAI (NVIDIA)
cloud._src: S-1: up to $120.5B, ~$3.1B/month at full delivery expected Dec 2026; cancelable on 90 days' notice after Jan/Mar 2027

cloud.label: AMD Helios
cloud._src: S-1: >$20B if full initial tranche procured; not in commitments table

financeLeases.label: Broadcom TPU leases (Anthropic Direct)
financeLeases._src: S-1: ~$161.2B rent excl. interest, 5-yr leases, some online 2026, more from 2027; finance-lease rate 7.1% (Note 7). Commencement split is an assumption.

calibration._src_notes: S-1: 1,840,444,962 Class N shares on conversion; FV $108,566M at 6/30/26
calibration._src_fdShares: Public Benefit Fund 846.84M shares = 5% of fully diluted
calibration._src_rsu: S-1: $2.9B catch-up + $23.7B over ~2.1 yrs if IPO at 6/30; $3.1B other awards; $5.8B new RSUs after 6/30

servingEff._note: Revenue per $ of serving compute. H1'26 cost of revenue $2,380M on $16,286M revenue => ~6.8-7.4

trainingPctRev._note: Desired training/R&D compute as % of revenue; committed capacity above serving needs also lands here

spotCap._note: 2026-10-27 (Bud): spot/flex compute capped at this share of contracted compute each quarter. Demand beyond contracted + capped spot is lost revenue, so new deals raise revenue when supply binds. Serving has priority: training is squeezed to trainingFloorPct of revenue before demand is turned away. null = unlimited spot (pre-10/27 behavior).

priceWar._note: 2026-10-27 (Bud): revenue = volume x price; serving cost follows volume. Intensity 0 = preset path; 100 = Q4'30 serving margin of floorMargin. Extra quarterly price cut is back-solved. floorMargin 35% ~ commodity inference sellers today (Cerebras 39% GM 2025; OpenAI blended 33% 2025).

capacityResale._note: 2026-10-27 (Bud): only management response modeled. Once adjusted operating margin < trigger for triggerQuarters in a row, resell committed compute above serving + training needs at recoveryPct of cost, ramping in over rampQuarters. Netted in the compute line. Headcount/G&A cuts deliberately not modeled (too small vs compute).

futureCommit._note: New compute commitments beyond the named contracts: adds stepAdd $M/qtr each quarter

ipo._src: Press speculation: $100B+ raise at $1.5-2T. Google option up to $10B at IPO price (S-1).

amdEquity._src: S-1: AMD to buy up to $5.0B Class N tied to GPU deployment

common._minLiquidity_note: S-1 covenant floor is $5.0B; model keeps a $10B operating buffer before drawing the revolver
common._nol_note: S-1: $8.2B federal NOL at 12/31/25; plus H1'26 operating losses (rough)

workingCapital._src: Calibrated to 6/30/26 balance sheet (AP ex-$1.2B Bartz accrual)

high.label: High Momentum — The Amazon Path
high._bud: 2026-10-26: Q4'26 sequential growth starts at 40% (matches reported ~$110B YE26 run-rate expectation)
high._bud_newDeals: 2026-10-28: new-deal preset lowered from 2500 to 250 so supply just keeps pace with demand (clean 'everything goes right' case). At 2500 the path carried $134B of idle compute 2027-30; the slider is now how readers explore overbuilding.

decel.label: Deceleration — The Cisco Path
decel._bud: 2026-10-26: big cloud deals back-loaded; SpaceXAI cancelled; no new commitments after 2028; Google TPU tranche deferred (2 yrs assumed)

decline.label: Decline — The AOL Path
decline._bud: 2026-10-26: AOL-style displacement. Product still works, but commoditization erodes price faster than cost. Gradual erosion, no single shock. Same contract assumptions as Deceleration.
